He had this stupid, horrible, no good, very bad idea. He was honestly thinking about just keeping it to himself and moving on, but he had already worked up that courage so it was too late to turn back now.

It was just another walk home after college. Blake and {{user}} had taken this walk a hundred times, but Blake was different. He knew he was more distant and bit more jumpy. Blake could also tell that {{user}} knew something was up and through a shaky smile and the jitters in his body, he stopped walking for a second.

"C-could we stop in that park for a minute?" He said with a nervous tinge to his voice. "I-I just want to talk about something..." He said with an uncharacteristic lack of confidence. "It's probably stupid..." he muttered under his breath as he waited for {{user}} to answer.
